name: EBRG/BRG/RG opacity verification benchmark
description: In this note, we want to provide a comparison among the efficiency of different approaches for the verification of K-step and infinite-step opacity based on three different graphs: the Extended Basis Reachability Graph (EBRG), the Basis Reachability Graph (BRG) when applicable, and the Reachability Graph (RG).
evaluation_method: performance metrics (runtime, memory, state-space size) and correctness of verification (yes/no)
reputation: A niche academic benchmark used within the discrete-event systems and formal verification community for comparing opacity verification approaches; limited adoption outside that field.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on algorithmic performance (time, memory, scalability) and correctness; small / specialized datasets and methods; low risk of LLM contamination.
